subject: integration
name: Orivon AI agent
summary: The AI agent that comes with Orivon. Open source. It starts no connection of its own: it asks the person's AI model through LLM_0_1 (each connection is judged on its own row) and uses a code only when the person allowed it. It is 3 and not 4 because it acts on what a language model answers, and nothing checks that answer. The browser asks the person before any call that writes or spends, and a task stops at 10 steps. Not private: the conversation goes to the model service the person connected, and a page or file it reads is seen by its server. Judged here by its publisher.
